reviewNote: Former operator confirms acquisition and 2025 decommissioning. New TOR2 specifications at 151 Front Street are excluded; this profile preserves the historical 1 Yonge identity.

identity.notes: Amanah explicitly identifies its acquired Cogeco-Peer1 facility at 1 Yonge Street, matching both imported operator and address.

sources.title: Amanah — company history and 1 Yonge decommissioning

facts.label: Operator change — 2015
facts.value: Amanah acquired the former Cogeco-Peer1 facility at 1 Yonge Street in 2015.

facts.label: Facility closed — 2025
facts.value: Amanah reports decommissioning this location in 2025 as part of the waterfront redevelopment. Its replacement TOR2 facility is at a different address, 151 Front Street West.

facts.label: Historical inter-building connection
facts.value: Before closure, a private dark-fibre link connected 1 Yonge with Amanah’s 151 Front Street facility. This is not a current service offer.

facts.label: Former facility address
facts.value: 1 Yonge Street, Toronto, Canada; decommissioned in 2025
